## Types

### `role` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

What a player may do on this server.

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `player` | A normal player. |
| `moderator` | Listed in the server's moderator list. |
| `admin` | Listed in the server's admin list. |
| `owner` | The server owner / console operator. |

### `player` <Badge type="info" text="resource" />

A handle to one player, owned by the host. It stays valid while the player is connected; after they leave every method returns `api-error::stale-handle` (or a default value for infallible getters).

| Method | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `func() -> string` | The player's stable id as sent by the game client (the vanilla `playerID` string). |
| `alias` | `func() -> string` | The player's current alias (display name). |
| `is-online` | `func() -> bool` | True while the player is connected. |
| `role` | `func() -> role` | The player's role on this server. |
| `send-chat` | `func(text: string) -> result<_, api-error>` | Sends a chat line only this player sees. Needs no permission. |
| `pos` | `func() -> option<pos>` | (0.2) The tile of the player's blockhead; `none` when it is not in the world or the player left. |
| `value-handle` | `func() -> u64` | (0.2) The host handle that stands for this player inside values (`{"$h": handle}`, see `types.value`), for example in service arguments. |
| `kick` | `func(reason: string) -> result<_, api-error>` | Disconnects the player with a reason text (shown to modded clients; vanilla clients see the generic kick message). Needs the `players:kick` permission. |

Lua: methods are called with `:`, for example `player:id()`.

### `get` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

### `from-value-handle` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt

```

(0.2) The player behind a host handle from a value; `none` when the handle is stale (the player left).

### `find-by-alias` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt

```

Looks up a connected player by alias (case-insensitive).

### `online` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
online: func() -> list<player>;
```

All connected (approved) players, in join order.

### `broadcast` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
broadcast: func(text: string) -> result<_, api-error>;
```

Sends a chat line to every player, shown as a server message. Needs the `players:chat` permission.
